exposure: Color Doppler Ultrasound (CDUS) for prenatal diagnosis
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) for prenatal diagnosis
cohort: Thirty pregnant females with high clinical risk of placenta accreta, all having a history of previous cesarean section, underwent both CDUS and MRI.
finding: Both CDUS and MRI demonstrated fairly good sensitivity for prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta, with CDUS showing 87.5% sensitivity and MRI 75.0% sensitivity, and no statistical difference between them.
